name: std::chrono::zoned_time<Duration,TimeZonePtr>::operator local_time<duration>, std::chrono::zoned_time<Duration,TimeZonePtr>::get_local_time
intro: Obtains a std::chrono::local_time<duration> representing the local time in the time zone corresponding to the time point *this represents.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A std::chrono::local_time<duration> computed as if by zone->to_local(get_sys_time()), where zone is the non-static data member holding the stored time zone pointer.

summary: Obtains a std::chrono::local_time<duration> representing the local time in the time zone corresponding to the time point *this represents.
